fixes.explanation: It's the opposite. The words from Isaiah, Israel's prophet, say, “These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.” The hearts are far from Him, not near. That gap is exactly what Jesus is pointing at.
Amazed isn't the word here. The disciples tell Jesus, “Are You aware that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?” So the Pharisees were offended, not amazed. The text gives us that word.

That's the route. Jesus says, “…whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then is eliminated?” So food takes a trip through and out. Then He says the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart (Matthew 15:18).
Both are on His list. Jesus says, “…evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, and slander.” This is a heavy list, baker. Jesus says these come out of the heart.
